Items need no Reflect or Sync

div.div:
Lifecycle and execution limits
Last sender dropped → drain accepted commands → exit; no join acknowledgment.
Unwinding panic → discard state and drop later commands so callers receive errors.
Handler errors do not roll back mutations; long commands delay all later work.
Never call blocking handles from this worker: it cannot service its own queue.
